Select a checkbox to add an app to the MultiStar cover list; clear it to remove the app. Tap an app name to try opening it on the current screen. Tap Refresh after installing a new app.

If MultiStar icons have not refreshed, switch to another cover widget and back.

Option 1: install and authorize from a computer with ADB.
Option 2: install the APK on your phone. With Shizuku running, open Setup, choose Shizuku authorization, and allow the request. Permission is granted once; a continuous connection is not required.

Shizuku v13 or newer must be running, and you must be able to open this tool for the first time. Installing Shizuku alone is not sufficient.

Only MultiStar 9.1.09 is supported for writing. No Internet permission is requested. Undo checks for changes made by other apps.

Change the interface language under Setup → Language.
